how_gold_was_made: Hand count by the agent: the detector's numbered boxes were overlaid on the full-resolution sheet and every part of both wings was read at 0.24-0.4x tiles plus 1x zooms of doubtful spots; each box was marked correct or wrong and every unboxed door / window symbol was added as a miss. Anchored on the detections, so a miss that looks like nothing at tile zoom could still be absent from the gold. Rules: a double door counts once; folding and ajar-leaf doors count; sliding doors count; exterior windows = each glazed panel between solid piers in an outside wall; internal glazed screens / side panels are not windows.

vector_pdf_doors (third pass).method: door swings read from the PDF's own linework: chains of short stroke pieces (tessellated arcs) fitted to circles; quarter arcs (60-120 deg, >= 3 pieces, fit error <= 3 %) of door-leaf radius (0.5-1.5 m at the printed ratio, else the dominant quarter-arc radius) count; partial (30-60 deg), short (2 pieces) or rough (<= 8 %) arcs count only with a straight leaf ~r long from the hinge; runs of identical arcs < 1.3 r apart (lockers) are dropped; pairs closing towards each other = one double door
